source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Map reconciliation against the Playland by the Sea souvenir map. The existing reviewed fixture layer already preserves 49 of the 52 numbered attractions; this file recovers the three map-only omissions without inventing unsupported stock or pricing.

entities.name: Ticket Gate
entities.source_summary: Numbered park entrance on the souvenir map. The Playland planning text on the same page establishes paid park entry, Daily Ride Wristbands and à-la-carte ride passes.

entities.name: Changing Rooms
entities.source_summary: Numbered changing-room amenity on the souvenir map. The nearby Hydrosubsidium Artificial Ocean entry explicitly states that changing rooms and swimsuit rentals are located nearby.

entities.name: VIP Parking Lot
entities.source_summary: Numbered VIP parking area on the souvenir map. No separate parking price, access transaction or other customer-facing commercial terms are stated in the reviewed Playland text.
